title: jsemzvosku.cz
text: End-to-end development of a custom e-shop for a handmade soy candle brand, built without an off-the-shelf platform. It covers a product catalog with size variants and gift sets, guest checkout, card and Apple Pay / Google Pay payments, Packeta and personal pickup shipping, automatic invoicing, and an admin panel the owner runs the shop from. Performance-tuned on Cloudflare Workers with edge image resizing, plus transactional e-mails and brand design.
